changelog:
Initial release of “concept-validation-gate-review-workbench”, the core tool for concept validation directors (老胡) to manage project Gate reviews.

- Supports complete 5-Gate review system, covering project screening, technical/commercial/exit reviews.
- Implements "Four-Light" decision mechanism (绿灯/蓝灯/黄灯/红灯) with detailed criteria for each Gate.
- Enables blue-light condition tracking and management for conditional approvals.
- Facilitates multi-path resource allocation and route-switching decisions.
- Provides structured review workflows, role responsibilities, and standardized reporting templates.
